about: What a gym may change in the Ventricle design. Everything not listed here is protected: the ECG monitor and its eight-stage scroll (heart rates, zone tags, the PR burst), the zone ladder and plate colours, the 1RM calculator and barbell diagram, the busy-floor chart, layout, spacing, type scale, breakpoints and all interaction code.
rules: Text may not contain < > { } or line breaks.

The hero is a fixed eight-stage heart-rate climb (resting, warm-up, four zones, brace, PR). hero.words are the eight big words shown on the monitor, in that order; hero.captions are the seven captions for stages 2-8.
schedule.week: Monday to Sunday, each a list of ["HH:MM", class index] in time order, [] for a day without classes. Every class in schedule.classes must appear at least once.
Three membership tiers, cheapest first; the middle one is highlighted with join.popularTag. Yearly billing charges 12 - join.freeMonths months.
hours.week: Sunday to Saturday, null = closed, open and close as HH:MM.
theme.accent doubles as heart-rate zone 5 and the 25 kg plate, so it must stay clear of the blue, yellow and green plate colours.
Class names are at most 18 characters: on a phone the free-session list shows "Tomorrow 05:15 · name (Z4)" in one select box, and WebKit widens the form to its longest option.
